name: k-delegate
description: Lets Claude Code hand small, well-scoped tasks to a cheaper DeepSeek model in isolated git worktrees, then review the result before it reaches your branch

api_key.title: 1. API key (required)
api_key.description: Step 1 of 2. Paste your personal DeepSeek API key, issued by Kodffe. Stored in your system's secure credential store, never in the project. Then go down to step 2.

model.title: 2. Model (optional)
model.description: Step 2 of 2. Which DeepSeek model runs delegated tasks. deepseek-flash (default): fast and cheapest, right for most tasks. deepseek-v4-pro: stronger, about 4 times the price. Then choose Save.
